description: This file defines an internal interface ICacheMetrics that describes cache metrics such as hits, misses, evictions, and hit ratio, used within the Orleans.Core caching system.

classes.name: ICacheMetrics
classes.description: Represents cache metrics collected over the lifetime of the cache. Provides properties to access hit ratio, total requests, hits, misses, evictions, and updates.

methods.name: HitRatio
methods.description: Gets the ratio of hits to misses, where a value of 1 indicates 100% hits.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Gets the total number of requests made to the cache.

methods.name: Hits
methods.description: Gets the total number of cache hits.

methods.name: Misses
methods.description: Gets the total number of cache misses.

methods.name: Evicted
methods.description: Gets the total number of evicted items.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Gets the total number of updated items.
